card.name: Medical specialty and title words
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of medical field names, trial titles and specialty names, such as Clinical, Medicine, Endocrinology or Endoscopic, where the name is not yet finished.

card.writes: It suppresses adjective words like applied, comparative and preventive, which suggests it steers away from a discipline-style adjective next.
